reason: B provides the cleaner paired intervention on the same as-deposited material and more directly tests whether defect-mediated exchange disorder controls low-field hysteresis and ΔS(T), whereas A confounds deposition route, grain size, texture, stress, and defect density and inconsistently predicts broadening despite a narrowed exchange distribution. B is somewhat incremental and should quantify its predicted changes, but it is physically and experimentally more defensible for a first-order magnetostructural system.
